minor.issue: PRE-EXISTING (not iter69): returns 500 for driver_waybill_1778553153 — Pydantic ValidationError 'vehicle_type' and 'license_number' fields missing on the driver doc in DB. The DriverProfile response_model rejects the record. Other endpoints (my-stats, my-activity, my-score-history) work because they don't use the strict response_model. Recommend: backfill these fields on legacy driver records OR make them Optional on DriverProfile schema.

action_items: OPTIONAL/pre-existing: Fix /api/drivers/profile 500 for legacy drivers missing vehicle_type/license_number (backfill in DB or mark fields Optional in DriverProfile pydantic schema). This is the source of the two '500' console errors seen on /chauffeur/profile page (the page still renders fine because it uses Promise.allSettled).

OPTIONAL: _resolve_palette falls back to palettes[0] when points exceed all palette ranges (test driver has 102 points but Debutant maxes at 100 → still shows 'Debutant'). Consider returning the highest palette instead when points > max.
critical_code_review_comments: DriverHome.js useEffect deps include `currentRide` & `isOnline` — handlers re-subscribe on every state change (acceptable but adds churn). Cleanup unsub1/unsub2/unsub3 is correctly returned.

RideTrackingPage.js: toast.error has duration=7000 but navigation triggers after 4000ms — toast outlives the page navigation (sonner is global so this is fine, but the description states 'after 4s navigate', so 4000 is correct).

DriverScorePage.js: chart series reconstruction assumes history is in chronological reverse — works as long as backend returns most-recent-first (it does via `list(reversed(...))[:50]`). Verified live.
